content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Using BT Rules ## slug: av-using-bt-rules ## seoTitle: Using BT Rules ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End The BT Rule component's user interface is a point-and-click environment for creating, editing, and deactivating {{variable.Object_BTRule}}s. Please note that users may need admin-level technical abilities to use this feature. Also, users will see the following messages when Advanced Visibility or Caching 2.0 is not enabled for their org. * When a user tries to access the BT Rule component: “You cannot use this component because the Advanced Visibility feature is not enabled for this org.” * When a user tries to create a {{variable.Object_BTRule}} or {{variable.Object_BTRuleCondition}} record: “You cannot create records of this object because the Advanced Visibility feature is not enabled for this org.” ## Functionality ### BT Rules * Users can click the **Deactivate rule**/**Activate rule** button to deactivate or activate the {{variable.Object_BTRule}}. * When a {{variable.Object_BTRule}} is deleted, all the associated {{variable.Object_BTRuleCondition}} records are also deleted. * If a {{variable.Object_BTRule}}’s {{variable.Field_BTRule_Active}} field is unchecked, the {{variable.Object_BTRule}} is treated as if it were deleted. * A {{variable.Object_BTRule}} will be recalculated If an associated {{variable.Object_BTRuleCondition}} is deleted. The following happens when a user creates or updates a {{variable.Object_BTRule}} record. * The {{variable.Object_BTRule}}’s {{variable.Field_BTRule_Process}} field is set to “True” (checked), and the {{variable.Field_BTRule_LastUpdateDate}} field is set to the current date and time. * If it hasn't been created already, the Blackthorn | Base Adv Visibility Hourly Sync scheduled job will be created. The scheduled job runs once an hour and triggers the FilterRecordsSyncBatch batch job for any {{variable.Object_BTRule}} records with {{variable.Field_BTRule_Process}} = “True.” * The scheduled job also checks the date/time in the {{variable.Field_BTRule_LastUpdateDate}} field, looking for records with a {{variable.Field_BTRule_LastUpdateDate}} after the scheduled job’s start date/time. If the {{variable.Field_BTRule_LastUpdateDate}} is before the scheduled job’s start date, the {{variable.Field_BTRule_Process}} field will be set to “False.” * NOTE: Setting {{variable.Object_BTRule}} {{variable.Field_BTRule_Process}} = “True” (checked) will not cause the {{variable.Object_BTRule}} to be processed immediately. It will be processed during the next scheduled job. **Additional Functionality** * The Blackthorn | Rule Filter: Contacts Preview Fields (RF_Contacts_Preview_Fields) field set on the Contact object allows users to change which fields are displayed on the Eligible Contacts Preview component. * Users who edit a {{variable.Object_BTRule}} from an Experience Cloud site and click {{variable.Button_Save}} will see the first ten Contacts listed in the Eligible Contacts Preview list. The user can sort the list by any column header and click the Contact name to view the Contact record. * For Express Registration, eligibility will be calculated based on all the Account’s Contacts. ### BT Rule Conditions * Users can create multiple {{variable.Object_BTRuleCondition}}s for a single {{variable.Object_BTRule}}. * Only {{variable.Object_Contact}} fields visible to the user will be available for the user to select with the field selector. Formula fields are not available. * The data type permitted in the {{variable.Field_BTRuleCondition_Value}} field is determined by the value selected in the {{variable.Field_BTRuleCondition_Field}}. For example, for date fields, the value must be a date; for number fields, the value must be a number. * The {{variable.Field_BTRuleCondition_Operator}} function picklist is controlled by the data type of the {{variable.Field_BTRuleCondition_Field}} selection. For example, greater than or less than are only available for number fields. * To prevent errors when creating a {{variable.Object_BTRuleCondition}}, the user must select a value in the {{variable.Field_BTRuleCondition_Field}} field before selecting a value in the {{variable.Field_BTRuleCondition_Operator}} field. * Adding, removing, or editing a {{variable.Object_BTRuleCondition}} or changing the {{variable.Field_BTRule_ConditionType}} (Conditions - AND/OR/custom) will automatically refresh the page upon saving. The following happens when a user creates or updates a {{variable.Object_BTRuleCondition}} record. * The {{variable.Field_BTRule_Process}} field on the related {{variable.Object_BTRule}} record is automatically set to “True” (checked), and the {{variable.Field_BTRule_LastUpdateDate}} field is set to the current date and time. * If it hasn't been created already, the "Blackthorn | Base Adv Visibility Hourly Sync" scheduled job is created. The scheduled job, which runs once an hour, triggers the FilterRecordsSyncBatch batch job for the {{variable.Object_BTRule}} records with {{variable.Field_BTRule_Process}} = “True.” * The scheduled job also checks the date/time in the {{variable.Object_BTRule}}’s {{variable.Field_BTRule_LastUpdateDate}} field, looking for records with a {{variable.Field_BTRule_LastUpdateDate}} after the scheduled job’s start date/time. If {{variable.Field_BTRule_LastUpdateDate}} is before the scheduled job’s start date, the {{variable.Field_BTRule_Process}} field will be set to “False.” #### Special Scenarios Sometimes, you may not want to wait for the nightly scheduled job, which takes a while, to update {{variable.Object_Contact}} eligibility. Scenarios where that is the case can include the following. * You made a bulk update to several existing {{variable.Object_Contact}}s and want to see how those changes impact {{variable.Object_Contact}} visibility for a specific {{variable.Object_BTRule}}. * You created three {{variable.Object_BTRule}}s, which were successfully processed. Later, you added new {{variable.Object_Contact}}s, but you only want {{variable.Object_BTRule}} #1 to be recalculated for those {{variable.Object_Contact}}s. If one of those scenarios occurs and you don’t want to wait for the nightly scheduled job to see the updated {{variable.Object_Contact}} eligibility, complete the steps below. 1. Select a specific {{variable.Object_BTRule}}. 2. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon. 3. Check the {{variable.Field_BTRule_Process}} field. 4. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. This will cause the logic to run after an hour. (The {{variable.Field_BTRule_Process}} field will automatically revert to unchecked after the logic runs.) #### Condition Logic The {{variable.Object_BTRuleCondition}}’s logic dictates how the conditions interact and works as follows. * Users can dictate whether conditions are combined using AND statements, OR statements, or a custom combination of AND and OR statements, including parenthesis. * The interface supports complex logic such as (1 and 2) or 3) or 4 or (5 and (6 or (7 and 8))). * An error message will be shown if the following logic errors are made. * A defined condition is not referenced. * There is an incorrect number of parentheses or a spelling error. * There is an undefined filter (blank value). * Potential operators for {{variable.Object_BTRuleCondition}}s include the following. * CONTAINS * DOES NOT CONTAIN * EQUALS * EXCLUDES * GREATER OR EQUAL * GREATER THAN * INCLUDES * LESS OR EQUAL * LESS THAN * NOT EQUAL TO * STARTS WITH ## Eligibility vs Visibility ### Events #### Visible + Eligible * The current user meets the visibility and eligibility criteria, so they can see and register for the {{variable.Object_Event}}. * If the current user meets the visibility and eligibility for an {{variable.Object_Event}}, and the {{variable.Object_BTRule}}’s {{variable.Field_BTRule_ExtVisibilityAcct}} and {{variable.Field_BTRule_ExtEligibilitAcct}} fields are enabled (checked), then all {{variable.Object_Contact}}s related to the Account/Bucket Account can register for the {{variable.Object_Event}}. #### Visible + NOT Eligible * The user can see the {{variable.Object_Event}} webpage but can’t register because they aren’t eligible. #### Eligible + NOT Visible * If a user meets the eligibility criteria but not the visibility criteria, they can be registered for the {{variable.Object_Event}}, but they won’t be able to see the {{variable.Object_Event}} webpage. #### NOT Visible + NOT Eligible * If a user does NOT meet the visibility and eligibility criteria, they will see an error message when visiting the {{variable.Object_Event}} webpage. ### Event Items #### Visible + Eligible * If a user meets the visibility and eligibility criteria, they can select any {{variable.Object_EventItem}} and register for the {{variable.Object_Event}}. #### Visible + NOT Eligible * If a user meets the visibility criteria but does not meet the eligibility criteria, they can see the {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s but cannot select one. (The Choose Ticket Type section shows only visible {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s.) #### Eligible + NOT Visible * If a user meets the eligibility criteria but not the visibility criteria, they can be registered using the {{variable.Object_EventItem}}, but they won’t be able to do it as they can’t see the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} on the {{variable.Object_Event}} webpage. #### NOT Visible + NOT Eligible * If a user does not meet the visibility and eligibility criteria, they will not see the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} and cannot register for the {{variable.Object_Event}} using the {{variable.Object_EventItem}}. ### Sessions The {{variable.Object_Session}} page layout was updated to implement visibility and eligibility rules for applying advanced visibility to {{variable.Object_Session}}s. #### Visible + Eligible * Users can register for the {{variable.Object_Session}} if they meet the visibility and eligibility criteria. * If a {{variable.Object_Session}} is visible and eligible for the current user and the {{variable.Object_BTRule}}s {{variable.Field_BTRule_ExtVisibilityAcct}} and {{variable.Field_BTRule_ExtEligibilitAcct}} fields are enabled (checked), then the {{variable.Object_Session}} will be shown in the dropdown list, and all {{variable.Object_Contact}}s related to the {{variable.Object_Account}} can add it to their cart. #### Visible + NOT Eligible * A {{variable.Object_Session}} is visible, but users cannot add it to their cart. * If a {{variable.Object_Session}} is visible and eligible for the current user and {{variable.Object_BTRule}}{{variable.Field_BTRule_ExtVisibilityAcct}} is enabled (checked), but {{variable.Field_BTRule_ExtEligibilitAcct}} is not enabled (unchecked), then the {{variable.Object_Session}} will be visible in the dropdown list, but only the current user can add it to their cart. The {{variable.Object_Contact}}s related to the {{variable.Object_Account}} can see the {{variable.Object_Session}}, but they can’t add it to the cart. **Example ** * Contact A has visibility. * Contact B has NO visibility. * If Contact A and Contact B are in the same {{variable.Object_Account}} and {{variable.Field_BTRule_ExtVisibilityAcct}} = “True” (checked), then Contact B will have the same visibility as Contact A. #### Eligible + NOT Visible * If eligibility rules are applied to {{variable.Object_Session}}s, only eligible {{variable.Object_Contact}}s will see them on the payment screen. * If the current user meets the eligibility requirements for the {{variable.Object_Session}} and {{variable.Object_BTRule}} {{variable.Field_BTRule_ExtEligibilitAcct}} is enabled (checked), then the current user and all eligible {{variable.Object_Contact}}s can register for the {{variable.Object_Session}} even if they can’t see it. * If a registrant is not eligible to sign up for a {{variable.Object_Session}}, they will see the following message: “Eligibility requirements need to be met to add this session.” **Example** * Contact A meets the eligibility rule criteria for Session 1. * Contact B meets the eligibility rule criteria for Session 1. * Since Contact A & Contact B are in the same {{variable.Object_Account}} and {{variable.Field_BTRule_ExtVisibilityAcct}} = “True” (checked), then Contact B will have the same visibility as Contact A (see the Visibility example). * Contact A and B’s names will be in the {{variable.Object_Session}}’s dropdown. * Contact C is in the same {{variable.Object_Account}}, BUT they do not meet the eligibility rule criteria for Session 1. Therefore, Contact C will have the same visibility as Contacts A and B, but Contact C’s name will NOT be in the {{variable.Object_Session}}’s dropdown. #### NOT Visible + NOT Eligible * Invisible {{variable.Object_Session}}s will be hidden from the {{variable.Object_Session}} layout. ## Updated Checkout Logic Users cannot change an {{variable.Object_Attendee}}’s information to a non-eligible {{variable.Object_Contact}} for {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s during checkout unless the Someone Else option is visible. This ensures only eligible {{variable.Object_Contact}}s can change their information when purchasing Tickets for the {{variable.Object_Event}}. When a user who is not eligible tries to access the cart/checkout pages, the following error message appears: “You do not have access to this event. Please contact the event organizer for more information.” ### Scenario 1: Contact Selection Users can only select eligible {{variable.Object_Contact}}s for {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s on the Attendee Details page. Non-eligible {{variable.Object_Contact}}s, however, will not be visible in the {{variable.Object_Contact}} selection dropdown. * User A: Eligible Contact for the Main event ticket. * User B: Non-eligible Contact for the Main event ticket. * During checkout, the following will occur. * User A can select themselves, provide contact information, and purchase the main event ticket. * User B is not visible in the selection dropdown. ### Scenario 2: Someone Else On the Attendee Details page, the Someone Else option in the {{variable.Object_Contact}} selection dropdown is configured as follows. * {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_DisCheSElse}} = “True” (checked) → Users can click **Someone Else** and fill in their information. * {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_DisCheSElse}} = “False” (unchecked) → The Someone Else option is unavailable; only eligible {{variable.Object_Contact}}s are listed in the dropdown. ## Create a BT Rule :::(Warning) (Limitation) Using {{variable.Field_BTRule_ExtVisibilityAcct}} is not recommended for organizations with more than 1,000 Contacts in a single Account. ::: ### Enable Contacts as Customer Contacts If you plan to create {{variable.Object_BTRule}}s to match {{variable.Object_Contact}}s in the "BT Rule Condition's Eligible Contact Preview" section, you must first enable those {{variable.Object_Contact}}s as customer contacts. 1. Open a {{variable.Object_Contact}} record. 2. Click the lightning button dropdown menu. 3. Click **Enable Customer User**. 4. If you plan to extend eligibility/visibility from one {{variable.Object_Contact}} to other {{variable.Object_Contact}}s within an {{variable.Object_Account}}, you must also enable those {{variable.Object_Contact}}s as customer contacts. *IMPORTANT NOTE:* {{variable.Object_Contact}}s who do not have access to Experience Cloud (i.e., not enabled as customer contact users) are not eligible for Advanced Visibility rules. ### Create a New BT Rule 1. Click the App Launcher. 2. In the Search box, enter and click “BT Rules.” 3. Click {{variable.button_new}}. 4. Enter a {{variable.Field_BTRule_RuleName}}. (required) 5. Check {{variable.Field_BTRule_ExtVisibilityAcct}} if you want everyone in the {{variable.Object_Account}} to see the {{variable.Object_Event}}, {{variable.Object_EventItem}}, or {{variable.Object_Session}}. 6. Check {{variable.Field_BTRule_ExtEligibilitAcct}} if you want everyone in the {{variable.Object_Account}} to be able to select the {{variable.Object_Event}}, {{variable.Object_EventItem}}, or {{variable.Object_Session}}. ![Create a new BT Rule](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Create%20Demo%20Rule.png){height="" width=""} 8. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ## Create a BT Rule Condition 1. Create a new {{variable.Object_BTRule}} or open an existing one. 2. Complete the following required fields. * {{variable.Field_BTRuleCondition_Field}} * {{variable.Field_BTRuleCondition_Operator}} * {{variable.Field_BTRuleCondition_Value}} * {{variable.Field_BTRule_ConditionType}} (Conditions) ![Create a new BT Rule Condition](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Create%20Demo%20Rule%20Condition.png){height="" width=""} 3. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ## FAQ **Q: I don't see a specific person in the Contacts preview. How do I fix that?** A: If you don’t see a person in the Contacts preview, please check the following settings. 1. Go to Setup. 2. In the Quick Find box, enter “Digital Experiences.” 3. Click “Settings.” 4. Confirm that you can see your Digital Experience sites. 5. If you can, move on to the next step. If you can’t, please review your Digital Experiences site setup. 6. Click the Object Manager tab. 7. In the Quick Find box, enter “Account.” 8. Click Account. 9. Click the Page Layouts tab. 10. Click Account Layout. 1. Click the Mobile & Lightning Actions navigation tab. 2. Drag and drop **Enable as Partner** onto the page layout. 3. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. 4. Open an Account record. 5. Click **Enable as Partner**.
